title: SPL Toolkit v1 shared wire definitions

grammar_registered.description: Local parser registration fact; independent of syntax coverage.

closure.Relation.description: Relation evidence is one half-open UTF-8 byte range in the definition document or one JSON Pointer property. Runtime checks range bounds and byte boundaries.

closure.Definition.description: Macro arity and arguments must agree; the runtime validates this and exact relation byte ranges.

closure.DefinitionBundle.description: Caller-supplied scoped definitions. Runtime rejects duplicate IDs and collection kinds.

closure.Binding.description: Half-open UTF-8 byte range; runtime validates the referenced document and exact occurrence.

closure.Request.description: Optional bindings are normalized to an empty array when omitted. Null and unknown members are invalid.

closure.SourceInterval.description: Half-open UTF-8 byte offsets into the indicated source; runtime validates ordering and source identity.

closure.ProvenanceSegment.description: Effective half-open byte interval and original source provenance.

closure.GraphNode.description: Evidence pointer identifies the source query, traversal entry, or invocation frame in the report.

closure.GraphEdge.description: From, to, and invocation node IDs refer to graph nodes; traversal pointer and edge ID refer to the same report traversal entry. Runtime validates all references. Origins retain ordered source ranges in a standalone graph; the traversal pointer resolves in the full report.

closure.BOMOccurrence.description: Path lists object IDs from the query to the reached object, including the reached object. Edge and instance IDs refer to traversal and graph evidence; runtime validates references.

compatibility.Request.description: Strict offline request. Ownership, unique binding IDs, canonical revision and graph/reference consistency are checked by the runtime. Duplicate JSON keys, malformed Unicode and lexical fractional versions are rejected by the decoder.

resolution.Request.description: Strict names-only resolution input. Runtime checks marker/site and original-role key membership, duplicate JSON keys, malformed Unicode, lexical integer encoding, and cross-query references; schemas cannot establish proof authority.

resolution.PreparedRequest.description: Strict names-only resolution input. Runtime checks marker/site and original-role key membership, duplicate JSON keys, malformed Unicode, lexical integer encoding, and cross-query references; schemas cannot establish proof authority.

diagnostic_details.description: Explicitly opted-in diagnostic field, including caller-supplied structured failure detail.

environment_metadata.description: Explicitly opted-in captured metadata field or authored schema; does not restore a complete report.

workflow.GraphEdge.description: Workflow closure edges retain canonical fields, with IDs scoped to the original/candidate subject and traversal pointers rebased into the source workflow report.

workflow.BOMOccurrence.description: Canonical BOM occurrence with edge ID scoped to its original/candidate workflow subject.
